input_bindings.role: preflight boundary and failure-mode regression tests

prior_findings_and_dispositions.finding: Static recipe/source hashes were not mandatory.
prior_findings_and_dispositions.disposition: Required static bindings and exact frozen recipe assertions added; tests reject missing bindings and changed recipe parameters.

prior_findings_and_dispositions.finding: Path reopening could separate the hashed source/recipe from bytes subsequently inspected.
prior_findings_and_dispositions.disposition: Recipe is parsed from the verified byte buffer; source hash and HDF5 access share one O_NOFOLLOW file descriptor.

prior_findings_and_dispositions.finding: A failed terminal receipt write could leave an ambiguous consumed attempt.
prior_findings_and_dispositions.disposition: Exclusive started receipt is file- and directory-synced before probes; atomic terminal replacement failure leaves a durable non-success record and blocks retry.

prior_findings_and_dispositions.finding: Import-time thread/GPU environment mutation affected test callers.
prior_findings_and_dispositions.disposition: Environment limits are applied only by the CLI entrypoint; sentinel regression test added.

prior_findings_and_dispositions.finding: mtime alone did not detect same-size in-place source modification with restored mtime.
prior_findings_and_dispositions.disposition: ctime_ns is included in pre/post hash and HDF5 identity signatures; a same-size in-place mutation test restores mtime and expects fail-closed behavior.

next_step: Wait until the active F3 material worker is no longer competing for CPU, then consume the single explicitly authorized F4 r002 CPU-native preflight. A passing preflight still does not authorize tracer/canary runtime execution.
